about: The whole event log of a scratch Dispatch built from this repository, read through GET /api/v1/events/log after a run of the census's story on 2026-11-21. OTHR-1's spec holds a person's approval of its latest version. ACME-1's spec holds a person's request for changes and no approval. OTHR-2's spec holds a person's approval of version 1 and stands at version 2. LEGION-1's spec holds a person's approval, and LEGION-1 is done. LEGION-2 under OTHR-1, LEGION-3 under LEGION-1, LEGION-4 under ACME-1 and LEGION-5 under OTHR-2 each open a spec-approval ask. LEGION-2 and LEGION-3 each hold a message in the format of basisOpenedMessage (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/gate_basis.go), naming OTHR-1 and LEGION-1 as the ancestor, and the person then approves LEGION-2's spec. That Dispatch refused a parent of another project, so each such link was written in its database and reached the log in the issue.updated of a label write.
